scope: date alignment, finite current volume contexts, future-volume perturbation of feature pipeline, model interfaces; zero market fits

manifest.rule: current log1p volume minus median of valid volumes in prior 60 target records; divide prior standard deviation floored .25, clip [-5,5]; require >=10 past valid rows
manifest.missing_rule: context=(0,0) means absent information; never asserts volume itself equals zero
manifest.information: author-reported current-day Volume assumed available after that day's report; exact publication vintage/unit not certified
manifest.input_information_span: 64 return tokens; each volume token uses up to 60 earlier target records for its reference
